process.eyebrow: From an idea to your website
process.title: A clear path to your first impression.
process.description: We agree what we're building, what it costs and when it can start.
process.choose.title: Choose a direction
process.choose.body: Explore the demos and tell us what you like. We'll agree a design brief that fits your business and the scope.
process.prepare.title: Share your business details
process.prepare.body: Prepare your approved copy, usable images and contact details. Confirm your language package, final total, payment and scheduled start with us.
process.review.title: Review your website
process.review.body: Check the first delivery, send all your eligible corrections in one list, then approve publication.
process.timing: We build your site in {baseDeliveryDays} working days, counted from the day everything is ready: payment, final approved content, images and other assets you have the rights to use, language package, design brief, approvals, contact details and a confirmed start date. Extra languages add the working days listed for their package.
faq.title: Good questions. Clear answers.
faq.included.question: What does the base package include?
faq.included.answer: One responsive page in one selected language, adapted to the agreed brief and content limits. It includes {hostingMonths} months of hosting and {correctionRounds} round of eligible corrections, sent as one list. The standard base is LKR {standardPrice}; confirm your final total before payment.
faq.languages.question: Can my website use more than one language?
faq.languages.answer: Yes. The base includes one selected language. Choose a fixed add-on package for one or two additional languages from Sinhala, Tamil and English. Extra cost and working time depend on the package. Each version needs approved copy before publication.
faq.domain.question: Are hosting and a custom domain included?
faq.domain.answer: The base includes {hostingMonths} months of hosting on an approved WebBlitz subdomain. Custom domain registration and fees are not included. Hosting renewal is optional at LKR {renewalFee} for each further {renewalMonths} months; it does not happen automatically.
faq.content.question: What do I need to provide?
faq.content.answer: Your final approved business copy, usable images with permission to use them, and working contact details. We'll also confirm the language package, design brief and necessary approvals. Use the content checklist to prepare.
faq.delivery.question: When does the delivery time start?
faq.delivery.answer: The {baseDeliveryDays}-working-day build time starts once everything is ready: payment, final content, usable assets and the rights to use them, language package, design brief, approvals, working contact details and a realistic start date. A message or payment on its own doesn't start the clock. Language packages add the working days listed for them.
faq.corrections.question: Can I request changes after the first delivery?
faq.corrections.answer: Send all your eligible corrections as one list within {correctionHours} hours of first delivery. This covers fixes to facts or text, and swapping an image for a similar one. New sections, layout changes and changes to the approved brief are outside the base package and need separate scope.
faq.demos.question: Will I get every feature shown in a demo?
faq.demos.answer: The demos are fictional design references, not a promise to copy a site exactly. Some show custom interactions that need separate scope and pricing. We'll confirm what your website includes before payment.
faq.enquiry.question: Does sending a message book a build slot?
faq.enquiry.answer: No. A WhatsApp message is an enquiry. We'll confirm the scope, written total and build availability with you before payment.
faq.more: Read the full scope and terms

checklist.title: Bring your business into focus.
checklist.description: Gather the details below, then talk to us on WhatsApp. It's only a checklist; nothing here uploads or sends your information.

checklist.business.body: Prepare your business name, a short introduction and the approved facts you want customers to know.
checklist.services.title: What you offer
checklist.services.body: Prepare the products or services you want to include, with approved descriptions and prices where relevant.
checklist.images.title: Images you can use
checklist.images.body: Choose clear images and confirm that you have permission to publish them.
checklist.contact.title: How customers can reach you
checklist.contact.body: Check your phone, WhatsApp, email, location and opening hours. Include only the details you approve for publication.

checklist.language.body: Choose Sinhala, Tamil or English for the base page. Tell us if you need additional languages.

checklist.design.body: Note the demo you like and the parts you would like to keep or change within the agreed scope.
checklist.note: Sending a message does not book a build slot or start the build time. We'll confirm the scope, written total and scheduled start with you.
